questions.prompt: A rule gains 0.03% on the average trade before costs. Each round trip costs 0.04% in spread. What is true?
options: It has an edge of 0.03% a trade
It has an edge of 0.07% a trade
It breaks even, because the spread is paid only once
It loses 0.01% on the average trade, so it has no edge after costs
questions.explanation: An edge must survive costs: 0.03% - 0.04% = -0.01% a trade. The rule loses money, however often it wins.

questions.prompt: Why does a casino earn a reliable profit from an advantage of only 2.70% a bet?
options: Because it takes a huge number of bets, so the small tilt adds up
Because the advantage grows with each spin
questions.explanation: Any one bet can go either way, but over many bets the casino keeps about 1 of every 37 units bet on a single number.

questions.prompt: Shares must offer a higher return than safe government bills, or nobody would hold them. Which source of edge is this?
options: A risk premium, because holders are paid for carrying the chance of a fall
A market rule, because funds must buy at set times
Costs, because shares pay the spread
questions.explanation: A risk premium is the extra return earned for holding a risk others do not want. The chance that a share's price falls is that risk.
